props.custom_logic_action:
const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][Thrown Weapon]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

return;

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// Resolve attacker

// --------------------------------------------------

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerActorUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

""

);

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve attacker actor.");

return;

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// Read DEX die size

// User note: dex die size is at .dex_current

// I included a few safe fallbacks just in case.

// --------------------------------------------------

const dexDieRaw =

foundry.utils.getProperty(attackerActor, "system.props.dex_current") ??

foundry.utils.getProperty(attackerActor, "system.actor.props.dex_current") ??

foundry.utils.getProperty(attackerActor, "system.dex_current") ??

foundry.utils.getProperty(attackerActor, "dex_current") ??

0;

const dexDie = Math.floor(Number(dexDieRaw) || 0);

if (!Number.isFinite(dexDie) || dexDie <= 0) {

console.warn(TAG, "Invalid dex_current. No thrown-weapon bonus applied.", {

attacker: attackerActor?.name ?? null,

dexDieRaw

});

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.meta.thrownWeapon = {

applied: false,

reason: "invalid-dex-die",

dexDieRaw

};

return;

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// Roll 1d(DEX die size)

// Example: dex_current = 8 -> roll 1d8

// --------------------------------------------------

const roll = await (new Roll(`1d${dexDie}`)).evaluate({ async: true });

const rolledBonus = Number(roll.total ?? 0) || 0;

// --------------------------------------------------

// Add rolled result to existing damage bonus

// Base damage is already on the item, so we only touch bonus.

// --------------------------------------------------

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

const bonusBefore = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = bonusBefore + rolledBonus;

// --------------------------------------------------

// Debug stamp

// --------------------------------------------------

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.meta.thrownWeapon = {

applied: true,

dexDie,

rollFormula: roll.formula,

rollResult: roll.result ?? "",

rolledBonus,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

};

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

attacker: attackerActor?.name ?? null,

dexDie,

rollFormula: roll.formula,

rollResult: roll.result ?? "",

rolledBonus,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});
